# THE WALL: NAMES AND LAST SEEN [color=#7B776F]Pinned. One post per person. If you see your person here and you did not post them, tell porch_light.[/color]
### #1 porch_light (mod) (OP) // 83.01.04 This is the wall. Write them the way you would want a stranger to remember them. The rules are on the front page. We read every post.
### #2 papa_of_tomas // 83.01.09 [bold]Tomas R., 24, drill operator, Chances Claim.[/bold] Last seen going down for second shift on the deep level, 83.01.02. Blue work jacket with the elbow patched in green because I patched it and I had no blue. He hums when he is nervous, always the same song from the festival.
The mine says there was a collapse on the deep level and the shift was lost. The mine also says they cannot open the deep level to recover anyone. I have worked in mines. You open a collapse. You do not weld the lift shaft shut.
### #3 sister_of_mira // 83.02.11 [bold]Mira S., 31, filtration tech, Kutjevo.[/bold] Last seen at the outer pump house, 83.01.28. She has a scar through her left eyebrow from falling off a hab ladder when she was nine, she will tell you it was a knife fight. She wrote to me every week for six years. The last letter said they had moved her to a new section and she was not allowed to say which. She drew a little picture of a water drop in the corner of every letter. The last one has no drop.
### #4 cousin_of_the_two // 83.04.20 [bold]Dario K., 33, and Pavel K., 17, brothers.[/bold] Block C, taken in the curfew sweep, 83.04.02. Dario has a burn scar on his right hand from the canteen fryer. Pavel is tall for his age and wears his brother's old boots, two sizes too big, with paper stuffed in the toes. A man who came back from the garrison gym says both were put on a garrison transport on the second day.
The administration says there is no record of a detention. The garrison says enquiries go through the administration. We have been sent from one desk to the other eleven times. I count.
### #5 wife_of_aleks // 83.04.24 [bold]Aleks M., 40, survey team, Port Nereid.[/bold] Last seen leaving with the north jungle survey team, 83.03.30. Six of them went out for a three day job and none came back. He takes his wedding ring off for work and keeps it on a cord round his neck so it does not catch. If you find the cord, you have found him.
### #6 lena_s_brother // 83.05.01 [bold]Lena V., 27, hydroponics, Solaris Ridge.[/bold] Walked to the colony clinic after the quarantine on her block with a cough she could not shake. The clinic says she was transferred for specialist care, off-world, in medical stasis. Nobody asked us. Nobody told us where. She is allergic to the adhesive in medical tape. If she is on a ship somewhere, please, somebody tell them about the tape.
### #7 sister_of_ivo // 83.05.15 [bold]Ivo D., 36, machine shop, {colony}.[/bold] Last seen going into the south drainage culvert at 2200, 83.05.06, with two friends looking for lost animals. The friends came back. Security has listed him as having left the colony. There has been no shuttle. He is very big and very gentle and he talks to engines. If anyone hears a man singing badly underground, that is my brother.
[color=#7B776F][italic]Moderator note: Ivo's sister asked us to link the thread from the people who were with him. It is [netlink="here" link="reddog.deep/looking"]. Please be kind to them. They came back and told the truth when it would have been easier not to.[/italic][/color]
### #8 mother_of_jo // 83.05.18 [bold]Joanna T., 22, night orderly, a research site she was not allowed to name.[/bold] She took the night shift for the double pay. Stopped writing on 83.05.04. Her last letter said she had made friends with a man on her corridor who made her laugh, and that she said goodnight to him every night. She said goodnight to me every night too, when she was little. She would not go to sleep until I said it back.
### #9 porch_light (mod) // 83.05.19 Every name on this wall has someone who reads it every night. Thank you for keeping them here. If you have nothing to add, you can still read them. That counts.
